items.title: Frank Amacker Interview, 1960-09-30
items.q: Edward Clem? He's a nice cornet player, trumpet player... Edward Clem, he's pretty good.

ctx.x: Edward Clem? He's a nice cornet player, trumpet player. In those days they called it cornet. Didn't say trumpet like they do now. Edward Clem, he's pretty good.
Was he blonde or could he see a little or could he see well?
